notes: Live sync. Work on this computer or on the website and the two keep each other up to date on their own — your changes go up about 20 seconds after you make them and again the moment you switch away, and new data comes down by itself when nothing here is waiting to go up and you are not typing. If both sides have changes at once it stops and asks, so nobody's work is ever replaced without a click. There is a switch for it in Settings, Cloud Sync.
